subject: 16-Bit / Paid Auto routing-intelligence completeness audit (packages/paid-auto)
method: Static dimension-by-dimension audit of registry.ts, service.ts, evaluation-budget.ts, shadow.ts against the required routing-intelligence set. No paid credential, probe, or pricing lookup used — consistent with the quarantine boundary proven in R27-16BIT-EVIDENCE.json.

dimensions.detail: 4 fixed canonicalModelIds (gpt-5.6-luna, glm-5.3-flash, qwen3.8-flash, deepseek-v4.1-flash); direct + same-model OpenRouter fallback identities only; gateway auto-selection deliberately excluded
each route carries providerId + providerModelId + kind (direct|openrouter) + priority 1|2 + documentation source URL

per-route input/output costPerMillion with currency, unit, effectiveDate, lastVerified, and status CURRENT|UNKNOWN|STALE. Direct routes carry CURRENT pricing; every OpenRouter fallback is explicitly status:UNKNOWN with null costs — the registry refuses to fabricate fallback pricing
1M-token contextWindow on all four models plus maxOutput
verifiedAt + per-route sources[]; PAID_AUTO_VERIFIED_AT constant; shadow records default to MOCK provenance and require explicit attestation for OBSERVED_PRODUCTION
evaluation-budget.ts requires exact current non-low-confidence price card + explicit output bound, reserves below a finite campaign ceiling, releases reservation on served-model identity mismatch
no latency field or estimate exists anywhere in the registry; measuring latency requires paid provider calls that are not authorized — the absence is honest, not a fabrication
free models carry codingScore/agentScore consumed by ForgeZero; paid models carry no quality scoring — it cannot be sourced without running the models
no per-role (explorer/planner/coder/reviewer) suitability data; requires evaluation runs
no reliability or health metrics; requires live observation
fallback routes exist as identities + pricing status only; real failover is unmeasured

verdict.summary: The registry is complete on every dimension that can be honestly sourced without paid inference: identity, provider/model mapping, direct pricing, context, capabilities, route priority, freshness provenance, and budget admission. Every dimension requiring empirical measurement (latency, quality, role suitability, reliability, live fallback) is absent by policy rather than fabricated — consistent with the free-only boundary: no paid credential is authorized, and the server already blocks Paid Auto execution (PAID_AUTO_BLOCKED_BY_FREE_ONLY_POLICY).
verdict.blockingGap: None for the free-only product. A production 16-Bit intelligence claim remains impossible until owner-authorized capped paid evaluation runs exist (see R27-16BIT-EVIDENCE.json requiredNextEvidence).

testsCorroborating: vitest run packages/server/test/model-selection-boundary.test.ts packages/paid-auto/test/*.test.ts — 71 tests covering boundary, budget admission, reservation release, shadow provenance (R27 evidence, unchanged this audit)
